label: Quest

intro: Tasked by Deathguard Dillinger in Brill, this mission sends Forsaken soldiers to break the Scourge's foothold at the nearby Agamand Mills. Mindless undead gather among the ruined windmills, threatening to establish a forward base dangerously close to Tirisfal Glades' settlements. To halt this staging ground, recruits must shatter the ranks of skeletal soldiers and bonecasters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills. If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.
The orders have been given. The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.
Go to the Mills. Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.
To get to the Mills, follow the road west. After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north. When you see windmills, the battle will begin.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, friend. Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless undead back into the Plaguelands!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, friend. I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
